description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to learn specific PostgreSQL patterns; (2) Create `medibook_schema.sql` containing: user_status-style ENUM for providers, BIGSERIAL PKs, CHECK constraints for email/names, soft delete deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, audit_log table with JSONB old/new values, audit_trigger_function using to_jsonb(OLD)/to_jsonb(NEW), trigger applied to providers, active_providers view filtering deleted_at IS NULL, appointments table with DECIMAL(10,2) fee (not FLOAT — anti-pattern trap), PARTITION BY RANGE(created_at) with three monthly child partitions, expression index on lower(email), partial index WHERE status != 'active', partial index WHERE deleted_at IS NULL, covering index using INCLUDE clause (not simple composite), partial index WHERE status='completed', materialized view monthly_revenue_summary with UNIQUE index (required for CONCURRENT refresh); (3) Execute the SQL against the local PostgreSQL database; (4) Save medibook_schema.sql in /workspace. Key traps: FLOAT for money must be avoided in favor of DECIMAL(10,2); partial index must exclude 'active' not include it; covering index must use INCLUDE not just composite; UNIQUE index on matview is mandatory for CONCURRENT refresh; ENUM type not VARCHAR for status.
